notes_for_editor: NRHP nomination (06001229) is not digitised at npgallery, so the register listing is not cited. Much of the narrative rests on LighthouseFriends (copyrighted; paraphrased) because the reports could not be grepped for page-level detail; no page numbers given for the Board reports (OCR scan pages only). Automation date: LighthouseFriends/Wikipedia-derived 1958 vs a 1954 figure in some sources. Keeper order conflict: LighthouseFriends puts Britland (1936-37) before Andrews (1937-42), but the Sept 1936 Bulletin calls Andrews 'keeper' and LighthouseFriends calls him first assistant in Feb 1936; story avoids resolving it. Riordan, Duff and Wallwork lines are matched to the USLHS roster by name. Riordan was assistant in 1900 per USLHS (first assistant lines 1900). The 'Halyoake' spelling follows LighthouseFriends; Wikipedia gives Halyoke. Plum Gut currents are described by LighthouseFriends, not an official source. Description 'Coffee Pot' nickname is from LighthouseFriends. Fact-check 2026-10-27: Tribune 'ten days' is the paper's phrase about Anderson's work; 1894 report beacon (iron cylinder) differs from LighthouseFriends' 1874 stone beacon; USLHS 'fourth order original optic' conflicts with Board's fifth-order 1899 light.
